name: vectorcraft-plugin
description: Draw, edit, automate and export vector art in VectorCraft from Claude: the vectorcraft MCP server (live app or headless), plus skills for the app, automation scripting (ported from Illustrator ExtendScript), diagrams and drawings, and SVG audits.

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: auto: use a running VectorCraft (vectorcraft --control PORT) and fall back to headless. connect: the running app only. headless: an in-process engine, no app needed.

control_port.title: Control port
control_port.description: Loopback port the VectorCraft app listens on when started with --control PORT.

cli_path.title: vectorcraft-cli path
cli_path.description: Absolute path to vectorcraft-cli. Leave empty to search PATH and the usual install folders.

read_roots.title: Read roots (optional)
read_roots.description: Existing folders the agent may read from. Setting any read or write root confines file access and forces headless mode.

write_roots.title: Write roots (optional)
write_roots.description: Existing folders the agent may save and export into. Setting any read or write root confines file access and forces headless mode.
